title: listCatalog
description: Loads every tool in ID order through `ToolRepository.all` and gives each its catalog entry from the projection, on each request.

title: getOutcomeMeasures
description: Refuses an unknown time zone and answers with what the projection builds for the month, as of the moment it runs. The report TL-LEND-RP01 calls it from the command line; nothing is kept between runs.
